decisions.reason: The rejection overlooks the cited supplier proof: lem-c1-ode-flow-on-common-tube steps 3.1 and 4.1 explicitly prove the uniform difference-quotient remainder and uniform convergence of S on the entire compact interval. Those estimates justify steps 2.2 and 4.1 here; Gronwall gives the second-variation remainder and continuity. The undefined J in two proof lines denotes the explicitly fixed interval [0,T_+], with no mathematical ambiguity.

F4 attributed characteristic-polynomial multiplicity to an eigenvector-only definition. Replaced that attribution by the existing spectrum/root theorem and characteristic-polynomial definition, and explicitly fixed the root-multiplicity convention. The Jordan generalized-vector necessity argument and the invariant-complement inverse bound are sound; Statement unchanged.

The original F4 invocation did not supply the open initial neighborhood required by its common compact convex tube lemma. Replaced that supplier with the proved maximal-flow theorem on arbitrary open domains: successful cell induction gives existence, and open-domain flow differentiability identifies the variational block for every initial point, including boundary and degenerate boxes. The Euler LMh²/2 enclosure and Statement are unchanged.

The common-convex-tube sensitivity supplier did not apply to a periodic orbit in an arbitrary open U. Replaced F5 with the existing open-domain maximal-flow theorem and applied it explicitly to (θf,0); its state derivative gives B1+B2U(1,0)=J without assuming the orbit lies in a convex subset of U. The forced IVP construction, Euclidean X/Z norms and displayed inverse constant remain valid; Statement unchanged.

The p=0 identification overreached the phase-BVP definition when c=0. Qualified only that identification by c≠0, preserving the general jet for zero covectors. Also resolved the digest box-convention concern: rational query boxes remain admitted by the oracle, while operands and returned interval enclosures are explicitly rounded outward to finite dyadics, with failure inconclusive. The full parameter sensitivity, physical monodromy and period-column query retain their original exact formulas.

Section mode assembled a Jacobian in (x,μ,θ) columns for variables (x,θ,μ), so its Krawczyk callback need not enclose DF. Added explicit query-coordinate and Jacobian-column permutations before appending the section row, in both proposals and validation. Also repaired the digest domain mismatch by rejecting non-dyadic validation boxes before Krawczyk; specified its open convex C1 shooting domain and the BVP supplier nonzero phase covector. Finite budgets, complete partition, contraction and nonstationarity checks are retained.

The final sentence asserted a universal necessity of contour counting, whereas the proved result establishes only a separated simple-eigenvalue estimate. Replaced that unsupported methodological claim with the exact limitation of this bound. Checked the W projection, q≥1 for n≥2, exclusion of α=0, and the stronger denominator 1−Rqδ before its conservative replacement by 1−Rq²δ; the quantitative claim is preserved.

The generic continuation call requires a C3 shooting map on every requested fold subtube; C2 f supplies only C2 G. Added explicit verified C3 shooting-map evidence for fold requests and an inconclusive fold branch when absent, preserving ordinary C2 continuation and the separate fold tests. Also forwarded the corrected supplier dyadic-box/domain/nonzero-phase requirements and (x,μ,T) to (x,T,μ) Jacobian permutation. No higher flow regularity is asserted from the C2 theorem.

F4 cited an eigenvector definition for the characteristic-polynomial/root correspondence. Replaced it with the proved spectrum/root equivalence and monic degree-n lemma, explicitly stating the root-multiplicity convention. The resolvent identity gives the stated quadrature and matrix-family errors; Jacobi plus the argument principle counts precisely these roots, and the strict half-unit interval isolates the integer. The universal cluster-count Statement is unchanged.

F2 omitted the root-equivalence supplier existence/uniqueness premise, and step 2.1 did not explicitly obtain it before use. The successful corrector already includes the full-box Euler jet needed to establish that premise, so made F2 exact and invoked F3–F4 before the root-to-orbit implication. The complete partition, separate contraction and nonstationarity still establish the same unique root and nonconstant positive-period orbit; Statement unchanged.

Step 1.1 cited the Poincare-spectrum fact for a polynomial root count it does not state. Added the existing monic-degree, spectrum/root and complex root-count suppliers as F9 and corrected the tag. Checked the least-period reduction M_T=M_S^k, including generalized phase vectors; clarified that the Krawczyk nonsingularity check is at T, whose transverse phase also applies at S. Explicitly shrank to the relatively compact section patch required by the orbital-stability supplier. Statement unchanged.

F1 abbreviated corrector soundness as inclusion plus nonstationarity, omitting the separate uniqueness contraction and complete partition requirements. Replaced it with the full validated-root record, without changing the conditional Statement or inventing numerical data. Also made explicit polynomial field regularity, interior placement of the neutral multiplier, and the positive uniform disk margin obtained from compactness of the other polygon before applying orbital stability.
